notes.en: [[character:valeriy]] is a buff and shield support who is primarily used to increase the damage of [[element:electro]] or [[element:electro]] [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage. [[character:valeriy]] creates a shield with his [[ability:skill]]. He also uses his [[ability:skill]] and [[ability:burst]] to gain stacks for his enhanced [[ability:ca]], which increases the damage of [[element:electro]] or [[element:electro]] [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage based on his [[stat:atk]] and the number of stacks he consumed. [[character:valeriy]]'s buff will only work on [[element:stellar-conduct]] damage if he is in the Radiance: [[element:stellar-conduct]] state.
